checklist: relink-check.mjs (ladder-pr ci, homescoop#593): share/imagemagick/relink and share/imagemagick-heif/relink each relink magick with an override directory holding libiconv.a from the recipe's published @ai-ecoverse/wasm-libiconv and copies of the kit's libslicc_cred.a and libMagickCore (the heif kit also wasm-libheif's libheif.a, libde265.a and libdav1d.a); relink.sh must take each from there (homescoop#594)

the relinked magick.wasm validates, is within 2% of kit.json's size, has kit.json's import and export hashes (the binary the kit's objects made in the runtime build), a name section and no DWARF; the glue has callMain

ldflags.txt names only files in the kit (every --js-library in js/, no build-host path, homescoop#398); README.md's Relinking section, which THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md cites, names every static library of each kit (homescoop#564)

binding (homescoop#678): each kit's kit.json names the runtime package of the same version byte for byte: its bin/magick.wasm has kit.json's sha256, its package.json says homescoop.relink @ai-ecoverse/wasm-imagemagick-relink and its THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md names @ai-ecoverse/wasm-imagemagick-relink@<version>. The runtime is the same ladder-pr run's host-<recipe>-prN artifact (peers, .homescoop-out/peers; cert-review: HOMESCOOP_CERT_PEERS=$RUNNER_TEMP/artifacts), else the registry's <runtime>@<version>, else the check fails (no runtime of that version). Versions: this package, packages/imagemagick and packages/imagemagick-heif and both kit.json are one version (build.sh and relink-check.mjs fail otherwise)

7.1.2-34-9.1 (homescoop#562, #624): the kits' objects carry write-temp-then-rename.patch (MagickCore/constitute.c) and mogrify-format-over-existing.patch (MagickWand/mogrify.c); relink-check.mjs relinks both kits as before

7.1.2-34-9.2 (homescoop#561, #586, #679, #1208, #1258): the kits' objects carry timer-monotonic-emscripten.patch, jp2-tile-large.patch and the owner check in write-temp-then-rename.patch; relink-check.mjs relinks both kits as before
